Maintenance will begin at 11 AM on December 10th (JST), so please log out close to the start time.

Welcome toUNLIGHT:Revive!
1. UNLIGHT:Revive
The service of UNLIGHT:Revive has been started. Please note that the actual version is a beta version, so there may be some bugs.

2. Changes to game specifications
[Game System]
･The initial number of action cards is now 6
･The time limit for each phase (excluding character changing) is now 30 seconds
･The time limit for character changing has been changed to 15 seconds
･Simple help can now be displayed from the battle screen
･The FEAT Bonus that can be obtained the first time an Ex Skill is activated has increased by one
･Character Skills (with some exceptions) are now activated by the player who has the initiative
･For competing Character Skills (such as Counter Guard and 13 Eyes), the effect of the player who has the initiative is applied later

[Quest]
･The exploration and execution AP for each region has been changed

Exploration AP changed from 4 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 5 to 4

Exploration AP changed from 4 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 6 to 4

Exploration AP changed from 5 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 6 to 4

Exploration AP changed from 5 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 6 to 4

Exploration AP changed from 5 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 7 to 4

Exploration AP changed from 6 to 3. BOSS quest execution AP changed from 8 to 4
･Changed the effects of Ex Quest items.
The effect of Pass 1 has been changed from "Explore hidden areas (0 minutes)" to "Search for the hidden 1★+ areas of X"
The effect of Pass 1 has been changed from "Explore hidden areas (2 hours)" to "Search for the hidden 4★+ areas of X"
The effect of Pass 1 has been changed from "Explore hidden areas (3 days)" to "Search for the hidden 8★+ areas of X"
※The search time is "0 minutes" in all cases.
･A function to resume interrupted quests has been implemented
If a quest is interrupted due to disconnection from the server or unintentional factors, it can be resumed from the currently cleared square.
Please note that when resuming, you will start with the deck you started with.
･Changes to rewards for EXP squares
As a reward for EXP squares, you can now obtain a card of "current Lv-1 of the top character in the deck".
Example: If the top character in your deck is "Evarist Lv5", you will obtain one "Evarist Lv4" card as a reward.
Also, if the top character card in your deck is level 1, the level of the card you obtain will also be 1.
･Quests can be gifted to friends up to 5 times a day (reset at 4am (JST))
･When a gifted quest is cleared, the gifter can now obtain the reward for the final square (please note that in some quests, the reward will be replaced with GEMs)
･Emote stamps can now be attached when gifting a quest
･Emote stamps can now be attached when a gifted quest is cleared
The stamps you attach will be those you have added to your favorites in the "Emote Stamp" tab of the library.

[Duel]
･In-game chat has been abolished
･It is now possible to send emote stamps to your opponent during matches
･Surrender function has been added.
･In order to improve matching quality, restrictions have been placed on the cost and cards that can be used in Alexandre.
･Bonus game reward adjustments
The number of character cards that can be acquired has been increased.
In addition, it has been made possible to reach the maximum premium rank regardless of the rules or win/loss.
･Bonus games in Alexandre have been abolished.
This is to preserve the competitive environment, such as preventing intentional surrenders for the purpose of bonus games.
･A function has been implemented that allows you to send friend requests to your opponent.

[Card Crafting]
･The number of coins required to synthesize each fragment has been changed
Fragment of Memory: The number of iron coins required has been changed from 5 to 3
Fragment of Time: The number of bronze coins required has been changed from 5 to 3
Fragment of Spirit: The number of silver coins required has been changed from 5 to 3
･Improved the UI when using duplicate tickets
The UI has been improved to allow multiple copies to be duplicated at once.

[Others]
･Daily records have been revamped. Progress is possible regardless of the mode you play
① Play a quest or duel for X consecutive days
② Play another quest or duel for X consecutive days
③ Play another quest or duel for X consecutive days
･Records have been added for each character
･Friends can be added by entering their friend code
This friend code can also be used as an invitation code.
･You can now change the language from the options
We plan to add more languages ​​in future updates.
･When using "Fairy Potion", "Ancient Potion", and "Witches' Potion", you can now recover by exceeding the AP limit
･"Tickets (non-purchased)" can now be purchased with GEMs at the shop. The purchase limit is 10, and the number of purchases will be reset after maintenance at the beginning of the month.
･"Duplicate Tickets" can now be purchased with GEMs at the shop. The purchase limit is 10, and the number of purchases will be reset after maintenance at the beginning of the month.
･Various Fragments can now be purchased with GEMs at the shop. The each purchase limit is 10 of each item, and the number of purchases will be reset after maintenance at the beginning of the month.
"Diary of a Doll" can now be purchased with GEMs in the shop. The purchase limit is 1 item, and the number of purchases will be reset after maintenance at the beginning of the month.

QP/BP rankings will not be calculated in December.
